INSERT INTO nlp_analysis_log (
  request_id,
  text_preview,
  text_length,
  word_count,
  language,
  consensus_sentiment,
  sentiment_score,
  confidence_level,
  entities_detected,
  topics_detected,
  summary_text,
  providers_used,
  analysis_duration_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $json.input.text_preview }}',
  {{ $json.input.text_length }},
  {{ $json.input.word_count }},
  '{{ $json.input.language }}',
  '{{ $json.sentiment_analysis.consensus.sentiment }}',
  {{ $json.sentiment_analysis.consensus.score }},
  '{{ $json.sentiment_analysis.consensus.confidence }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.entity_extraction?.entities || []) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.topic_classification?.topics || []) }}',
  '{{ $json.text_summary?.summary || "" }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.providers_used) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.analysis_duration_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
